kills.property: After calling seedMarket when marketDrugs was 0, c.initialized must be true (so the contract becomes initialized).
kills.change_summary: Change setting initialized=true to initialized=false so seedMarket leaves initialized false after call.

kills.property: For any caller, calling DrugDealer() sets c.initialized() to the same boolean value on the reference (true/false) as the contract's previous initialized only when CEO sets address? — more directly: In the reference implementation, calling seedMarket via any actor who seeds market (after DrugDealer is used to set ceo) results in initialized being set to true by seedMarket; the mutant removing initialized assignment can leave initialized false after seedMarket, so there exists an input (a fuzzed seeder amount and caller) where initialized differs; therefore the general rule: after seeding the market via seedMarket by the CEO, c.initialized() must be true — the mutant can produce a case where it is false.
kills.change_summary: Remove the assignment to initialized entirely so seedMarket does not set initialized (leaving it unchanged).

kills.property: If seedMarket is called when marketDrugs==0, then afterwards either marketDrugs>0 or initialized==true (i.e., a zero-market seed cannot leave the contract both uninitialized and with zero market supply).
kills.change_summary: Set initialized only when drugs is nonzero; if drugs==0, initialized remains false.
